-p,  --plan <PLAN_ID>        Billing plan ID to use for the resource          
    $ vercel integration add neon -m region=cle1 -m auth=true
  - Install with a specific billing plan
    $ vercel integration add neon --plan pro
    region
      Choose your database region
      Options: cle1, iad1, pdx1, fra1, lhr1, syd1, sin1, gru1
      Example: -m region=cle1
    auth (true/false)
      Provide built-in authentication for app users, with profiles synced to Postgres.
      Example: -m auth=true
  Available billing plans for "Neon":
    free_v3    Free (Free)
    --plan free_v3
